definitions.explanation: The manager in charge of a department or division in a company.

examples.japanese: {部長|ぶちょう}に{報告|ほうこく}しました。
examples.english: I reported to the department head.

examples.japanese: {山田|やまだ}{部長|ぶちょう}は{厳|きび}しいですが、{公平|こうへい}です。
examples.english: Manager Yamada is strict but fair.

examples.japanese: {来年|らいねん}{部長|ぶちょう}に{昇進|しょうしん}するかもしれません。
examples.english: I might be promoted to department head next year.

notes: 部長 manages a 部 (department/division). It's a significant middle-management position. Used as a title (山田部長). In student clubs, 部長 refers to the club president/captain.
